name: music.sounds
title: Music sounds
summary: List the sounds the Strudel engine knows: name, kind (synth/sample/soundfont) and bank size, plus the bank names usable with .bank().
description: Boots the vendored Mucavex engine and its prebake (synth/ZZFX sounds, GM soundfonts, sample banks and drum-machine bank aliases), then returns the registered sound map as a lookup table. Use it before music.render to find a real sound name instead of guessing, e.g. filter for `perc` or `/^gm_dulc/`. `variants` is the number of samples in a bank (the range `n` accepts), or null for synths and soundfonts. `banks` lists every `.bank("...")` name, including drum-machine aliases; the engine lowercases bank lookups, so the returned lowercase names work as-is. Listing reads only the in-memory registry; no audio is loaded, so it works offline with a warm sample cache.

filter.description: Only return sounds whose name contains this case-insensitive substring, or matches this regular expression when the value starts and ends with `/` (e.g. `/^gm_dulc/`). Omit to return every sound.

kind.description: Only return this kind of sound: `synth` for oscillators/noise, `sample` for sampler banks, `soundfont` for GM instruments, or `all`.

offline.description: Only load sample maps and soundfonts from the sample cache, never the network. Omit (false) to allow downloading a missing map. Listing itself never loads audio.

name.description: Sound name to use with `s("...")` or `note(...).s("...")`.

kind.description: `synth` oscillator/noise, `sample` sampler bank, or `soundfont` GM instrument.

variants.description: Number of samples in the bank (the range `n` accepts), or null when unknown (synths and soundfonts).

banks.description: Every bank name usable with `.bank("...")`, including drum-machine aliases. Bank lookups are lowercased, so these lowercase names work as-is.

items.description: A bank name, e.g. `rolandtr909`, usable as `.bank("RolandTR909")`.

examples.title: List every known sound (needs the warm sample cache)
